May 22, 2016 - Pros: - The program is online, which brings extreme flexibility on when and where you want to study - It's also tuition-free: you might need to pay for an English certification (IELTS or TOEIC or something) and degree evaluation (to prove that your local bachelor degree is equivalent to a US-equivalent degree) but overall it's still cheap - The knowledge is good and applicable: I went through an interview at a local (3rd-world) shop for their Quant Trading position, and a lot of what was asked matched what I studied Cons: - The students: I won't say that all of them are bad, but I found many of them to have limited English skills, cannot program, and are heavily-dependent on AI/LLM for their writing.
